product.name: Virtual Depot Platform
product.description: A platform providing fleets access to private EV charging and parking spaces, enabling efficient distribution and utilization of electric vehicles.

product.name: Curo for Fleets
product.description: A service enabling commercial fleets to access and use Virtual Depots for electric vehicle charging and parking with flexible scheduling and safety protocols.

product.name: Curo for Hosts
product.description: A service for EV charging asset owners to lease their charging and parking spaces to commercial fleets, generating contracted revenue with managed access and security.
